commands.name: toggle-vim-ctrl-hjkl-keys
commands.title: Toggle Vim Ctrl + HJKL Keys
commands.description: Toggles Vim Ctrl+hjkl navigation keys in Karabiner (enabled <==> disabled)

preferences.name: ruleTitle
preferences.title: Rule Title
preferences.description: Exact title of the complex modification rule to toggle
preferences.default: Left ctrl + hjkl to arrow keys Vim

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
